bibl.title: Conservation interventions at the site of Berenike (Egypt): challenges and solutions in an ancient city of the Eastern Desert.
bibl.seg: Delia Eguiluz Maestro, Conservation interventions at the site of Berenike (Egypt): challenges and solutions in an ancient city of the Eastern Desert.
Iwona Zych (ed.), Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/2. Research on the Red Sea (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 211-223, figg.
bibl.note: Focuses on the specific conditions making this site unique and an ideal place for the preservation of all materials, paying special attention to the ancient harbor area with its significant number of remains of carbonized wood belonging on the whole to several ancient Roman ships.
